story_description: As a developer, I need stdio-based JSON-RPC communication with Codex CLI to stream assistant responses in real-time and accumulate incremental text deltas into complete messages.
task_description: Create a Swift Actor that accumulates item/agentMessage/delta events by itemId into complete text, emitting AssistantDelta events for UI streaming and AssistantComplete events when item/completed arrives.
atom: A001-CODEX-DELTA-ACCUMULATOR Actor for streaming text accumulation
atom_description: CodexDeltaAccumulator is a Sendable Swift Actor that maintains a dictionary mapping itemId (String) to accumulated text (String). On each item/agentMessage/delta event, it appends the delta text to the corresponding itemId entry and emits an AssistantDelta NormalizedEvent with the partial text. On item/completed event, it emits an AssistantComplete event with the full accumulated text, then removes the entry from the dictionary. Thread-safe by actor isolation, zero-copy where possible via String slicing.
problem_statement: Codex CLI streams text incrementally via item/agentMessage/delta JSON-RPC events, each containing a small text fragment for a specific itemId. The UI needs AssistantDelta events to render streaming text in real-time. When item/completed arrives, the full accumulated text must be emitted as AssistantComplete. Without an accumulator, the UI would either miss partial updates (batch mode) or lose track of which fragments belong to which message (no itemId correlation).
scope_in: Create CodexDeltaAccumulator as a Swift actor for thread safety
Maintain internal dictionary [String: String] mapping itemId to accumulated text
Implement accumulateDelta(itemId:delta:) method that appends delta and returns AssistantDelta event
Implement finalizeItem(itemId:) method that returns AssistantComplete event and clears entry
Handle multiple concurrent itemIds (e.g., tool calls interleaved with assistant text)
Implement reset() method to clear all accumulated state
Add itemCount computed property for debugging and testing
scope_out: Parsing JSON-RPC events into delta structures (handled by CodexEventMapper)
Handling non-text delta types (audio, images) - text only for now
Persistence of accumulated state across app restarts
Rate limiting or debouncing delta emissions
Batch aggregation for performance (emit every delta individually)
assumptions: item/agentMessage/delta events arrive in order per itemId
itemId is unique across the lifetime of a conversation turn
item/completed always arrives after all deltas for that itemId
Delta text is valid UTF-8 String from Codex CLI
constraints: Must be Sendable for safe cross-actor boundary passing
Must use actor isolation (not locks) for thread safety
Must not allocate excessively during high-frequency delta accumulation
Must handle empty delta text gracefully (skip emission)
Must not crash on finalize for unknown itemId (return nil or log warning)
functional_requirements: CodexDeltaAccumulator is declared as actor (implicitly Sendable)
accumulateDelta(itemId:delta:) appends delta to existing text or creates new entry
accumulateDelta returns AssistantDelta event with accumulated text so far
finalizeItem(itemId:) returns AssistantComplete event with full text
finalizeItem removes the itemId entry from dictionary after finalization
reset() clears all entries in the accumulation dictionary
itemCount returns current number of active accumulations
Empty delta strings are ignored and return nil from accumulateDelta
Finalize on unknown itemId logs warning and returns nil
nonfunctional_requirements: Accumulation of 1000 deltas for single itemId completes under 10ms
Memory per active itemId is O(accumulated_text_length) only
No actor suspension during dictionary operations (synchronous internal state)
Zero memory leaks when itemId entries are removed on finalize
implementation_steps: Declare actor CodexDeltaAccumulator conforming to Sendable implicitly
Add private var accumulations: [String: String] dictionary for state
Implement accumulateDelta(itemId: String, delta: String) -> NormalizedEvent? method
Check if delta.isEmpty and return nil early if so
Append delta to accumulations[itemId] or create new entry if nil
Return NormalizedEvent.assistantDelta with accumulated text and isPartial: true
Guard let text = accumulations.removeValue(forKey: itemId) else log warning and return nil
Implement reset() method that sets accumulations to empty dictionary
Implement var itemCount: Int computed property returning accumulations.count
Add inline documentation comments explaining the accumulation pattern
Add @available(macOS 13.0, *) attribute if needed for actor features

edge_cases: Empty delta string received - skip accumulation, return nil
Finalize called for itemId with no prior deltas - log warning, return nil
Multiple itemIds accumulating concurrently - each tracked independently
Very long text accumulation (megabytes) - no special handling, normal String growth
itemId reused after finalize - treated as new accumulation
Finalize called twice for same itemId - second call returns nil
Reset called mid-accumulation - all partial state lost (intentional)
Unicode delta that splits surrogate pair - rely on Swift String handling
failure_modes: Out of memory from huge accumulation - propagate Swift allocation failure
Actor reentrancy during accumulateDelta - not possible, actor is synchronous
Dictionary corruption - not possible with actor isolation
itemId contains unusual characters - String key, any valid String works
